    S

    SerializationGraph - Class in com.ads
    Maintains a serialization graph to detect cycles with two consecutive RW edges.
    SerializationGraph() - Constructor for class com.ads.SerializationGraph
    Constructor for SerializationGraph
    SerializationGraph.EdgeType - Enum Class in com.ads
    Types of edges in the serialization graph: - WW: Write-Write dependency (T1 writes x, T2 writes x, commit(T1) < start(T2)) - WR: Write-Read dependency (T1 writes x, T2 reads x, commit(T1) < start(T2)) - RW: Read-Write anti-dependency (T1 reads x, T2 writes x, start(T1) < commit(T2))
